listen.description: IP addresses or hostnames to listen on. Use ['*'] for all interfaces.

mail_location.description: Mailbox location format. Use 'maildir' or 'mbox'; '%u', '%d', '%n' are expanded variables.

auth_mechanisms.description: Authentication mechanisms to support. Avoid 'anonymous'; require SSL/TLS in production.

sql_passdb_config_path.description: Path to the SQL config file containing passdb (password) queries. Must exist and be readable by Dovecot.

sql_userdb_config_path.description: Path to the SQL config file containing userdb (user info) queries. Often same as passdb config.

log_path.description: Log destination. Use 'syslog' or path like '/var/log/dovecot.log'.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility for Dovecot logs. Options: 'mail', 'daemon', 'local0'–'local7'.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file.

mail_max_userip_connections.description: Maximum IMAP/POP3 connections per user per IP.

login_greeting.description: Greeting message shown on login. Use '$name' for service name.

quota_enabled.description: Enable per-user quota enforcement (requires quota plugin and filesystem support).

quota_storage_limit_mb.description: Default per-user storage quota in megabytes (used if quota_enabled).

quota_warning_percent.description: Threshold percentage to trigger quota warning (used if quota_enabled).

imap_port.description: IMAP plaintext port. Should be used only if SSL is required elsewhere.

ssl_imap_port.description: IMAPS (SSL/TLS) port. Set to null to disable.

ssl_pop3_port.description: POP3S (SSL/TLS) port. Set to null to disable.

mail_user.description: System user that owns mailboxes (for auth-userdb unix listener).
